cohort: A cohort of 628 women (314 with pregestational diabetes mellitus and 314 controls) delivering at a tertiary referral center.
finding: The triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index is a robust predictor of preterm birth, macrosomia, neonatal compromise, and composite adverse perinatal outcome (CAPO) in women with pregestational diabetes mellitus, while the atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) is inversely associated with fetal growth restriction.
